name: MoveYourBody
description: Privacy-first, open-source fitness app by AOSSIE: personalized 5–7 minute micro-workouts powered by on-device AI and voice control, running fully offline.
features: Personalized workouts (goals, fitness level, equipment, target body region)
Offline, on-device AI (quantized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via ONNX Runtime)
Custom workout creation, exercise search and body-focus sessions
